items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: a wonderful group of guys in New Orleans that were produced by Mark Howard. We played live in the same room, honestly.

ctx.x: Do you record — this may change from one CD to the next — but do you mostly record live with your band?

Yeah, you know actually I don’t — this last CD that I did, “Healing Time” is recorded with my band and we did record live for the most part. Yeah. Come to think of it, as far as the rhythm section yeah, we definitely did play live for “Healing Time.” And looking back I played live for the most part on most of my recordings, but not all. And I used studio musicians up until now and the last CD, “Healing Time,” is actually my band for the most part and I had a group of guys that, a wonderful group of guys in New…
Yeah I listened to “Healing Time” and there’s a phrase not so much anymore but, “Wow that jumps off the record.” And that tune jumps off the record.
